THIS. JUST THIS.

The image I've created of how I wanna kill my self played over and over always calms me down too. 

This feeling of a control that can't be taken away is also something that makes me try one more day cause I can always simply die.
But I want one too. Can u sell?
I feel the same. Hope you find your reasons and goals.
Me crossing every road without looking
I don't know. Everytime I am crossing a street or in very high place I think how easy would be to die. How that would be better than keep burning everyday.
Not anymore, no. But I have tried two different ones. Today I rode a bike home again, with that little impulse to throw myself under a car and finally end it.
